author: DanteMMartin
text: Google caught 'LLMjacking' crews turning stolen cloud creds into $100K/day of fraudulent LLM inference. Rotate your keys.

author: Tychoash
text: The Claude Code Extension Was Trojanized. Here's What 'Anthropic Hacked' Actually Means.

author: leomarshdev
text: langflow 1.0.0 through 1.12.8 has unauthenticated rce and an auth bypass. the public exploit only enumerates mcp tools. that list is a map of what your agents can touch.

author: zopdev
text: PHP has released an emergency fix for PHP2Shell, two critical flaws that let attackers take over servers without logging in. Exploit attempts began before the patch was even out.

author: ZeroZeroNews
text: Cyberattack hits Ikea, European stores.

author: RH_ISAC
text: Cybercriminals are weaponizing the OpenAI API. A new Python-based C2 framework named 'Nik' uses the API to execute system commands and control compromised hosts.

author: Xiba_AI
text: CVE-2026-102764 (CVSS 9.3) BeyondTrust Remote Support, actively exploited: unauthenticated file read/write leading to web shell. Patch BT26-05-RS.

author: exploitgrid
text: On Oct 29, Ivanti updated its Connect Secure (ICS) advisory to add 2 more vulns. CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 were exploited in the wild before disclosure.

author: TheHackersNews
text: Iran-linked DarkBlinders hackers compromised a high-profile Israeli individual and a government cloud environment in Iraqi Kurdistan, using fake apps, credential phishing, and a backdoor that relies on GitHub for command-and-control.

author: lyrie_ai
text: Binance, Oct 29: about $6.3B taken. Binance says the entry point was a DevOps engineer's compromised laptop, which reached a service container and submitted unauthorized withdrawals.

author: wahlbang07
text: Two critical Langflow flaws (CVE-2026-93680 and CVE-2026-110186) allow unauthenticated auth bypass and potential RCE. IBM rates both 9.8. Versions through 1.12.8 are affected; 1.13.0 fixes them. No confirmed in-the-wild exploitation so far.

author: zoomeyebot
text: CVE-2026-94300: ISC BIND 9 GSS-TSIG replay can corrupt memory. Critical vulnerability alert.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Still unpatched: Shadowserver tracks 1,000+ exposed GitLab servers open to CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10, exploited per CISA KEV) and 11,300+ open to a second regex RCE, CVE-2026-110264. Fixed in 19.4.2, 19.3.5 and 19.2.8.

author: z4v3n
text: CVE-2026-98432 is a remote unauthenticated use-after-free in the Linux IPv4 TCP handshake (kernels 4.4+). Kernel CNA and Red Hat rate it CVSS 9.8. Can leak kernel memory, crash systems, or enable RCE. Anthropic's AI ...

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: attackers are chaining three flaws to take unauthenticated root on VPN appliances. Ivanti has shipped fixes, and exploitation is confirmed in the wild.

author: zubiqo
text: Nvidia notified customers of a security breach on its Brev cloud platform that may have exposed SSH keys used to access virtual machines. Unauthorized activity ran for 16 days from Oct. 4 to Oct. 20 before Nvidia rotated the keys.

author: rtehrani
text: AU Small Finance Bank is investigating claims that data associated with some vehicle-loan customers may have been accessed without authorization, on a Salesforce-managed SaaS platform.

author: davidbombal
text: Copilot Told Researchers How to Hack It: researchers questioned Microsoft Copilot until it revealed a clue that helped uncover CoSnitch (CVE-2026-24301). A specially crafted link could automatically run an attacker's prompt inside Copilot.

author: viccy2025
text: Aider CVE-2026-115726: repo .aider.conf.yml shell RCE, CVSS 8.5. notifications-command / editor auto-load with no trust prompt (<=0.86.2), shell=True.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli; unauthenticated attackers could crash servers, steal data or execute code.

author: itsalreadywhen
text: Ivanti patched two more actively exploited Connect Secure zero-days now in CISA KEV, while a new VOLTA infostealer uses LLMs to triage stolen data.

author: BlockUnmasked
text: FBI and US Secret Service allege North Korean TraderTraitor hackers stole more than $6.3 billion from Binance last week.

author: intelphere
text: Russia's Emercom emergency app hit by a massive cyberattack sending fake nuclear alerts to 33 regions; similar fake alert in Ukraine.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: active exploitation confirmed (CVE-2026-104935). Upgrade and perform forensics if compromise suspected.

author: ManiarViral
text: Malicious npm packages steal GITHUB_TOKEN, AWS keys, KUBECONFIG, VAULT_TOKEN via preinstall hooks before your code runs. If it hit your CI or dev machine, assume breach.

author: HeyImMrMeeseeks
text: A VMware ESX logging flaw (CVE-2026-41709) was exploited as a zero-day by WARP PANDA against legal targets. Patch ESX per VMSA-2026-0006.

author: threatroundup
text: Cloud platform Northflank says assume all environment variables were decrypted after a breach Wiz flagged Oct. 30. Customers report stolen AI API keys being abused (LLMjacking). Via BleepingComputer.

author: CriminalIP_US
text: Nextcloud Built-in CODE Server (Collabora) RCE CVE-2026-110447 actively exploited to deploy web shells and search for sensitive files.

author: a13xp0p0v
text: Dangerous Device: Exploiting CVE-2026-31695 in the Linux Kernel via struct device. A stable PoC exploit for a race condition caused by a logical bug in network device management.

author: dailytechonx
text: Langflow versions 1.0.0-1.12.8 contain critical Remote Code Execution flaws and auth bypass holes. CVE-2026-93680 and CVE-2026-110186 let unauthenticated attackers run code. Auto-login default setting amplifies risk. Patch to 1.13.0.

author: rav4nn
text: An MCP tool could let strangers write to your server. JFrog disclosed CVE-2026-120338 on 1 Nov. It scores 10.0 out of 10 and hits Prefab UI's Generative UI sandbox, where a model writes Python that draws a live screen.

author: FLINTKYA
text: Between October 26 and 28, GitHub's advisory database published 112 malware advisories covering 106 npm and PyPI packages.

author: Maisco_Ai
text: We wrote 150,000 CVE exploits and trained an LLM on them. Hinoki Offensive One scores 88.4% on CyberGym with zero refusals.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: Ivanti has patched two additional Connect Secure vulnerabilities chained with an authentication bypass flaw in zero-day attacks targeting remote access gateways since at least October 1, 2026.

author: wahlbang07
text: CVE-2026-98432: Red Hat rates it Critical (CVSS 9.8). Anthropic used Claude to demonstrate unauthenticated root RCE on a vulnerable Linux MPTCP listener. Serious, but exposure depends on configuration.

author: Orion84x
text: Ivanti's second Connect Secure zero-day is confirmed exploited: chained with an auth bypass for root. No malware dropped, logs wiped, integrity scan clean. Gateways on 22.8R2.4 are in scope - patch and rotate.

author: CERT_UG
text: Patch Now | Nov 2. Drupal Commerce Core (CVE-2026-118539): active attacks, 42,000+ stores exposed. Ivanti Connect Secure: 3 flaws chained to unauthenticated root. Cisco ASA/FTD (CVE-2026-76418): unauth firewall crash, exploited.

author: ApollonVisual
text: Polymarket Reimburses $2.7 Million After Cyberattack. Polymarket confirmed a security incident affecting 726 customer wallets following a malicious script attack on 29 October 2026 via a third-party website monitoring provider.

author: f1tym1
text: Security researchers have released technical details and a working proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit for CVE-2026-31419, a high-severity Linux kernel vulnerability.

author: _pksharma
text: A person gets in. An AI agent does the long middle. A person comes back to detonate. That is how Sophos says the Aur0ra ransomware crew worked (Sophos CTU, 29 October).
